question: India's first fisheries business incubator was inaugurated by the Union Minister of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gurugram**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• India's first fishery business incubator was inaugurated by the Union Minister of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying in Gurugram in 2021.
 
• The government is expecting 22 million tonnes of fish production and Rs. One Lakh Crore export by 2025.
 
• The incubation unit can serve as a milestone for the future of the fishery sector.
